problem_dimension_n: <int> Number of cost dimensions shared by all scenarios.
num_scenarios_N: <int> Total number of scenarios in the original uncertainty set.
K_values: <list[int], length num_K> Target sizes for the reduced scenario set to evaluate.

selection_problem.n: <int> Number of items available for selection.
selection_problem.p: <int> Exact number of items that must be chosen in a feasible selection.

vertex_cover_problem.n: <int> Number of nodes in the graph.
vertex_cover_problem.num_edges: <int> Total number of undirected edges in the graph.
vertex_cover_problem.edges: <list[list[int]], shape [num_edges][2]> Pairs of node indices forming each undirected edge in the graph.

scenarios: <list[list[int]], shape [num_scenarios_N][problem_dimension_n]> Cost coefficient for each scenario in each cost dimension.
first_stage_costs: <list[int], length problem_dimension_n> Deterministic first-stage cost for each dimension in the two-stage formulation.
